name: Self Will
overview: Scripture reveals self will as a manifestation of a stubborn, stiffnecked heart that resists God's authority and guidance, as seen in the repeated descriptions of Israel in Exodus and Deuteronomy. This self-willed attitude leads to rebellion, unforgiven sin, and a refusal to heed God's messengers or correction, highlighting the danger of hardening one's heart against the Lord. The example in Genesis illustrates how self will can provoke anger and destructive actions, underscoring the necessity of humility and submission to God's will for His people.
